acceptedCandidates.sourceScope:
Primary edition: Williams/Penman, «Осознанность: как обрести гармонию в нашем безумном мире», MIF 2014, ISBN 9785000572139, translation Ю. Цыбышева, scientific editor Н. Никольская. The complete owned expanded EPUB was identified by metadata, 12 chapters and full spine; not a Smart Reading summary. Read-only access. This repair read the continuous central explanation in chapter 2 from «Наше беспокойное сознание» through the chapter end, the seven doing/being contrasts in chapter 3, the full weekly-progression section in chapter 4, principal complete instructions for body/breath (ch5), body scan (ch6), three-minute breathing space (ch7), sounds/thoughts (ch8), difficulty (ch9), befriending (ch10), day-activity balance and post-pause action (ch11), and continuation/motivation (ch12). Read additional whole passages for Alex, Lucy, raisin stages, habitual seat, expectations, movement limits and the cinema/whispering-commentary image. This gives the meaningful central argument and all eight program stages, not continuous cover-to-cover reading of every case, empirical claim, poem or note. EN is a new translation of this account, not collation with a complete EN edition.

Official author recordings page was inspected as a cross-check of this first book's practices; the later *Deeper Mindfulness* material is excluded. Current NCCIH safety page was consulted only for the separately identified safety qualification, not as the book's argument. Publisher web copy was inspected for identification, not accepted as efficacy proof. The anomalous 2001 copyright field in the RU package is not used to redetermine the English work's date.
reviewLimitations: Targeted primary passage verification, not continuous cover-to-cover reading or verification of every empirical claim, poem, note and omitted example.
The owned primary edition is Russian; English was reviewed against this condensation and checked primary meaning, not collated with a complete published English edition.

acceptedCandidates.sourceScope:
Primary edition: William B. Irvine, *A Guide to the Good Life: The Ancient Art of Stoic Joy*, owned complete English Oxford University Press EPUB, ©2009, ISBN 9780195374612. Package date is 2008; this is not used to invent a different work. Complete introduction, 22 chapters, reading program, notes and index are present, not a condensation. English primary text was the argument base. RU: *Радость жизни. Философия стоицизма для XXI века*, MIF 2021, translation Василий Горохов, scientific editor Станислав Наранович, ISBN 9785001461937; copyright information and the entire editor's preface were read directly. EN/RU publisher records were inspected for edition identity.

Actual reading for this repair: chapters 4–9 and 11–13 were read continuously through their full substantive text (negative visualization, control, fatalism, self-denial, review, duty, insults, grief, anger). Introduction opening and closing; chapter 2 opening, virtue/tranquility argument and conclusion; chapter 3 opening and ending; chapter 10 opening social-relations argument; chapter 14 opening banquet example; chapter 15 opening and substantive luxury/simple-pleasure passage; chapter 16 throughout its exile discussion and ending; chapter 17 opening and substantive closing argument on age/mortality; chapter 18 opening; chapter 19 opening and ending; chapter 21 opening recap, substantial evolutionary-justification section, modernization confession and ending; chapter 22 opening practice advice, rowing/self-contest section and the full closing self-assessment/doubts/invitation. Chapter 20 and other omitted subarguments are not newly certified. A tiny truncated interior boundary in the displayed chapter-15 housing passage is not counted as read and supports no claim. No claim of cover-to-cover reading of the full EN book or full RU translation. This establishes a meaningful coherent practical argument, not an exhaustive critical edition. Private extracts stay outside the repository.
reviewLimitations: Targeted primary-text verification of represented arguments and examples, not continuous reading or certification of the entire 22-chapter book, omitted chapter-20 polemics, every ancient quotation or note.
RU condensation was compared with English primary meaning. Full Russian published translation was not collated; its edition page and complete editor preface were checked.
Verdict covers only the hashed revised collector package. Root HTML at inspection still had 112 old pairs; publisher must integrate the approved revision.
No new clinical-efficacy certification or repeated browser/device matrix; author’s philosophy is not approved as treatment.

acceptedCandidates.sourceScope: The owned EPUB is a full expanded Russian edition: publication metadata, spine, all eight numbered books (0–7), methodology and endnotes present. Read the complete framing argument at the end of book 0, substantive self/interpreter argument in book 1, Greek/cultural comparison and transition passages, Pluscarden/Rogers/Perls/Esalen argument/reporting passages, self-esteem campaign documentary reporting and Smelser interview passages, the narcissism-versus-esteem experiment and disputed generational claims, economic/digital transitions, and the extended personality/conclusion argument in book 7. Checked the authentic-self reversal at ch1-20 p57, change/trait qualifications p39–51, accountability/projects/environment at ch1-21 p18–28 and the complete actual rocket ending p30–39. The methodology note was read in full. Longer narratives and some interiors were sampled, not read as a continuous 97,000-word text. This scope supports the represented argument and selected cases, not certification of the entire book or a comprehensive 2026 science update.
reviewLimitations: Primary reading was targeted across all eight numbered books, with the actual closing argument/rocket scene and methodology read in the specified continuous passages. Longer narratives and much interior exposition were not read continuously. No full-book reading claim.
No full English edition consulted. EN was read as a translation of the condensation and checked against the supplied Russian primary meaning.
This verifies the condensation’s representation of Storr, not the entire historical causal chain, primary clinical records, all underlying social psychology or a comprehensive current science update.
